name: Shanghai Hailiang Agriculture Group Co., Ltd. (上海海粮农业集团有限公司)
note: Grain group (growing, storage, processing, transport, sale), registered in Qingpu, Shanghai on 2023-02-15 with RMB 2 billion registered capital; legal representative Lu Yiming (卢一铭). Company-registration aggregator Qichamao lists two natural-person shareholders, Lu Yiming and Wang Abing (王阿兵); its shareholder page's percentages did not render (login wall for scripts). Liaoning Hailiang Agriculture Group Co., Ltd., which signed the Liaoning Tieren partnership, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Hailiang group per the group's own site.
